title: varrenmoor place spec v1
description: Input of illustrator/generators/place_create.py. Everything but `name` or `id` is optional; omitted fields take the defaults printed by `place_create.py prompt-help`.

id.description: folder name world/<id>/ (lower case, digits, underscore). Default: slug of name.

name.description: display name. Default: generated from the culture's name parts and the seed.

seed.description: same spec + seed = same place. Default: derived from the id.

culture.description: naming set (streets, buildings, districts) from presets/naming/*.json, and default building styles

size_ft.description: [width, height] of the place in feet. Default: from the population (about 2200 x 1400 for 600 people).

relief_ft.description: height of ridges / hills above the base plane

base_elevation_ft.description: elevation of the base plane at the map centre (default per recipe)

sea_level_ft.description: datum; ground below it is water (default 0)

sea_side.description: which map edge is the sea (coastal / fjord)

rivers.description: number of rivers (the first is the main one)

river_meander_params.description: explicit meander numbers: amplitude_ft, wavelength_ft, seed, width_var, bars (see river_meander.py)

layout.description: street pattern: organic (default), radial, grid, linear (along the main road), walled (compact rings + wall and gates)

districts.description: 'auto' or a list of 1-4 {name?, kind: civic|residential} from the centre outward; a farmland ring is always added last

entry_side.description: which map edge the main road comes in from (auto = from the recipe)

central_feature.description: market square (default), village green, temple / church beside the square, castle keep, or nothing

wall.description: town wall round the built-up districts with gates where roads cross (implied by layout walled)

farmland.description: farm fringe round the town (default true)

styles.description: 'auto' (from the culture) or {building kind: [style preset ids]} (presets/building_styles)

allow_large.description: lift the caps (a very big town can take minutes and a lot of memory)

draft.description: draft quality: coarse terrain, civic buildings only (no houses): seconds instead of a minute

foundry.description: links.foundry_scene etc. when the place came from a Foundry scene (import-scene)
